note: Canonical action table. Every recommendation this system makes is an entry here, and every entry names the statutory or clinical provision it rests on. Reviewed by: [pending clinical + legal sign-off].

owners.COUNSELLOR: NHAA helpline counsellor handling the interaction
owners.DYSP: Investigating officer, rank of Deputy Superintendent or above

info_entitlements.label: Explain entitlements and complaint process
info_entitlements.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Act s.15A(3) — right to be informed of rights and entitlements

counselling_referral.label: Refer to Tele-MANAS for scheduled counselling
counselling_referral.basis: National Tele Mental Health Programme; SC/ST (PoA) Act s.15A(2) — victim support services

priority_counselling.label: Priority counselling assignment within 24 hours
priority_counselling.basis: National Tele Mental Health Programme; SC/ST (PoA) Act s.15A(2) — victim support services

telemanas_warm_transfer.label: Live warm transfer to Tele-MANAS crisis counsellor
telemanas_warm_transfer.basis: Crisis escalation — immediate, live handoff, not a callback
telemanas_warm_transfer.note: Never a callback. The caller is not released from the line until a Tele-MANAS counsellor has accepted the transfer.

crisis_safety_plan.label: Complete a collaborative safety plan before the call ends
crisis_safety_plan.basis: Standard crisis-line practice following a positive C-SSRS screen

no_auto_close.label: Interaction may not be auto-closed; supervisor sign-off required

supervisor_review.label: Immediate supervisor review of the interaction

dlsa_intimation.label: Intimate District Legal Services Authority
dlsa_intimation.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Act s.15A(2) — right to legal aid; NALSA free legal services

dlsa_advocate_48h.label: Assign a DLSA panel advocate within 48 hours
dlsa_advocate_48h.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Act s.15A(2) read with s.15A(5)

s15a_entitlement_packet.label: Raise the s.15A entitlement packet (protection, legal aid, travel and maintenance allowance)
s15a_entitlement_packet.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Act s.15A(2)-(11); Rules 1995 Rule 11 — travel and maintenance

district_nodal_notify.label: Notify the district nodal officer the same day
district_nodal_notify.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Rules 1995 Rule 9 — nodal officer duties

dysp_intimation.label: Intimate the DySP-rank investigating officer
dysp_intimation.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Rules 1995 Rule 7 — investigation by an officer not below the rank of DySP

protection_assessment.label: Protection assessment for victim and witnesses
protection_assessment.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Act s.15A(11) — duty of the State to provide protection

witness_protection.label: Initiate witness protection measures
witness_protection.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Act s.15A(11); Witness Protection Scheme 2018

emergency_relief.label: Initiate immediate relief under the compensation schedule
emergency_relief.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Rules 1995 Rule 12(4) and the Annexure I schedule — relief payable in tranches at FIR, chargesheet and conviction

dependent_relief.label: Assess dependent relief and subsistence for the deceased's family
dependent_relief.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Rules 1995 Rule 12(4) — relief to dependents; pension and employment provisions

fir_registration_escalation.label: Escalate non-registration of FIR to the Superintendent of Police
fir_registration_escalation.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Act s.4 — wilful neglect of duty by a public servant; BNSS provisions on mandatory registration

sp_complaint_refusal.label: Register a formal complaint against refusal to record the FIR
sp_complaint_refusal.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Act s.4(2) — refusal to register a case is itself an offence

medical_examination.label: Priority medical examination and treatment
medical_examination.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Rules 1995 Rule 12(4); BNSS provisions on medical examination in sexual offence cases

medical_assistance.label: Arrange medical assistance and transport
medical_assistance.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Rules 1995 Rule 11 — travel, maintenance and medical facilities

cwc_notification.label: Notify the Child Welfare Committee
cwc_notification.basis: POCSO Act s.19(6) read with SC/ST (PoA) Act; JJ Act care and protection provisions

shelter_rehabilitation.label: Arrange shelter and rehabilitation for displaced persons
shelter_rehabilitation.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Rules 1995 Rule 12(4) — resettlement of displaced persons

boycott_intervention.label: Refer active social boycott to the District Vigilance and Monitoring Committee
boycott_intervention.basis: SC/ST (PoA) Act s.3(1)(zc) — social or economic boycott; Rule 17 — District Vigilance and Monitoring Committee

economic_relief.label: Assess relief for economic blockade or wage denial

policies.note: Critical is the only tier where the caller is not released from the line before a handoff is accepted.
Fires on the rule, not the tier. Independent of any score.
